name: Hotel Bel Ami
positioning: Hotel at 7 rue Saint-Benoit in Saint-Germain-des-Pres, set in a 19th-century building that once housed the printing press of Bel-Ami, with rooms, suites and apartments designed by architect Pascal Allaman, a Clefs d'Or concierge and a spa and fitness space run with Calma Paris
best_for: Travelers who want a Left Bank base steps from Cafe de Flore and Les Deux Magots
Guests who like contemporary design in a historic building
Visitors who want an apartment or suite rather than a standard room

facts.text: The hotel is at 7 rue Saint-Benoit in Paris's 6th arrondissement.
The rooms use natural oak, lacquered glass surfaces in subtle tones and clean graphic lines.
The hotel offers rooms, suites and apartments.
The hotel serves a Sunday brunch with an organic buffet of sweet and savory dishes.
The hotel has flexible spaces for hosting events.
The Saint-Germain-des-Pres Metro stop on Line 4 is a 3-minute walk from the hotel.
The hotel team can arrange private transfers at negotiated rates.
Charles de Gaulle Airport is about 55 minutes away by taxi or private transfer.

highlights.text: The hotel occupies a 19th-century building that once housed the printing press of Bel-Ami in 1885.
The hotel is steps from Cafe de Flore, Les Deux Magots and Place Saint-Germain-des-Pres.
The rooms, suites and apartments were designed by architect Pascal Allaman.
The hotel offers a dedicated wellness space in partnership with Calma Paris, combining spa and fitness.
The hotel has a Clefs d'Or concierge.

considerations.text: For parking, the hotel partners with a nearby parking garage.
Electric vehicle charging stations are available on-site for a charge.
WhataHotel notes room sizes are compact, typical of Parisian hotels.
